advancements.soulhome.alchemy_lab.descri: Set a room in your soul up for brewing.
advancements.soulhome.alchemy_lab.title: Bottled Up
advancements.soulhome.aquarium.descripti: Flood a room in your soul until it is an aquarium, and swim like you belong there.
advancements.soulhome.aquarium.title: Deep End
advancements.soulhome.arcane_sanctum.des: Make a place in your soul to study spells, and hold more magic for it.
advancements.soulhome.armoury.descriptio: Fit out a room in your soul as an armoury.
advancements.soulhome.armoury.title: Well Armed
advancements.soulhome.bedchamber.descrip: Make a room in your soul you could actually rest in.
advancements.soulhome.bedchamber.title: Sound Asleep
advancements.soulhome.bulwark.descriptio: Wall a room in your soul to hold rather than to make, and take a hit you should not have survived.
advancements.soulhome.bulwark.title: Held Line
advancements.soulhome.cold_storage.descr: Keep a room in your soul cold enough that fire and lava barely touch you.
advancements.soulhome.cold_storage.title: On Ice
advancements.soulhome.enchanting_room.de: Build a room in your soul worthy of an enchanting table.
advancements.soulhome.entered_soul_dimen: Hey wait, why is it so empty in here?
advancements.soulhome.farm.description: Grow enough in your soul that it counts as a farm.
advancements.soulhome.farm.title: Soul Food
advancements.soulhome.first_room.descrip: Build something in your soul that the world recognises.
advancements.soulhome.first_room.title: Furnished
advancements.soulhome.greenhouse.descrip: Grow a greenhouse in your soul lush enough to keep you fed longer.
advancements.soulhome.greenhouse.title: Green Thumb
advancements.soulhome.hearth.description: Build a hearth in your soul hot enough to temper a blade.
advancements.soulhome.hearth.title: Playing With Fire
advancements.soulhome.infected_grotto.de: Let sculk take a hollow in your soul, and keep it dark enough to spread.
advancements.soulhome.library.descriptio: Fill a room in your soul with books, and somewhere to read them.
advancements.soulhome.library.title: Inner Study
advancements.soulhome.main.description: Welcome to SoulHome. The way to your inner soul.
advancements.soulhome.main.title: SoulHome
advancements.soulhome.mead_hall.descript: Lay a hall out for company, and find you are worth more with people around you.
advancements.soulhome.mead_hall.title: Long Table
advancements.soulhome.mine.description: Dig a working mine out of your own soul.
advancements.soulhome.mine.title: Deep Down
advancements.soulhome.obtained_guide.des: Get hold of the guide, and read up on what a soul is for.
By using this key, you can transport yourself and nearby entities to your soul.
advancements.soulhome.powder_magazine.de: Store your charges together rather than scattered, and have something to throw.
advancements.soulhome.rift_chamber.descr: Set amethyst in a frame of obsidian, and learn to be somewhere else.
advancements.soulhome.rift_chamber.title: Short Step
advancements.soulhome.ritual_chamber.des: Set a room in your soul aside for the work spells are made in.
advancements.soulhome.shrine.description: Raise a shrine in your soul that holds a little of what death would take.
advancements.soulhome.shrine.title: Ember Kept
advancements.soulhome.stable.description: Keep stalls in your soul, and never walk back to where you left your horse again.
advancements.soulhome.stable.title: Answered Call
advancements.soulhome.storm_spire.descri: Raise a copper mast under open sky, with the rod at its tip and not at its foot.
advancements.soulhome.storm_spire.title: Reaching For It
advancements.soulhome.track.description: Lay out a track in your soul worth racing on.
advancements.soulhome.track.title: Built For Speed
advancements.soulhome.training_yard.desc: Build a training yard in your soul that teaches you to jump twice.
advancements.soulhome.treasury.descripti: Stock a treasury in your soul rich enough to draw a little extra from the ground.
advancements.soulhome.treasury.title: Ill-Gotten
advancements.soulhome.trophy_room.descri: Hang enough of what you've beaten on the wall of your soul to stand your ground.
advancements.soulhome.trophy_room.title: Mounted
advancements.soulhome.watchtower.descrip: Build high enough, and glassed in enough, to see what the stone is hiding.
advancements.soulhome.watchtower.title: Long Sight
advancements.soulhome.workshop.descripti: Fill a room in your soul with working machinery.
advancements.soulhome.workshop.title: Everything To Hand
